# PocketRoot 支持 / Support

## 简体中文

- 接入 Terminal、Files 或 Workspace：先阅读[应用接入指南](../Docs/IntegrationGuide.md)。
- 构建、RootFS 或设备问题：先检查[故障排查](../Docs/Troubleshooting.md)。
- 可以稳定复现的非敏感错误：使用
  [Bug report](https://github.com/jacklv-coder/PocketRoot/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)。
- 接入问题：使用
  [Integration help](https://github.com/jacklv-coder/PocketRoot/issues/new?template=integration_help.yml)。
- 新能力建议：使用
  [Feature request](https://github.com/jacklv-coder/PocketRoot/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)。
- 未修复的安全问题：不要公开提交，按[安全策略](../SECURITY.md)私下报告。

PocketRoot 不提供 RootFS 下载、许可证授权、App Store 审核保证或生产支持 SLA。

## English

- For Terminal, Files, or Workspace integration, start with the
  [Integration Guide](../Docs/en/IntegrationGuide.md).
- For build, RootFS, or device problems, check
  [Troubleshooting](../Docs/en/Troubleshooting.md).
- Use the
  [Bug report](https://github.com/jacklv-coder/PocketRoot/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
  form for reproducible, non-sensitive defects.
- Use
  [Integration help](https://github.com/jacklv-coder/PocketRoot/issues/new?template=integration_help.yml)
  for adoption questions.
- Use the
  [Feature request](https://github.com/jacklv-coder/PocketRoot/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
  form for product proposals.
- Do not disclose unpatched vulnerabilities publicly; follow the
  [Security Policy](../SECURITY.en.md).

PocketRoot does not provide RootFS downloads, licensing authorization, App
Store approval guarantees, or a production support SLA.
